# TEL - Thèses en ligne (HAL Theses)

> Open-access repository for French PhD dissertations and academic research, powered by HAL (Hyper Articles en Ligne) and CCSD.

TEL - Thèses en ligne is the official French national repository for doctoral theses, providing free access to PhD dissertations across all academic disciplines. It implements OAI-PMH protocol standards and supports self-archiving by researchers and institutions.

## Key Topics

- HAL Open Archive
- Open-access
- PhD dissertations

## Repository Overview

- [Home - TEL - Thèses en ligne](https://theses.hal.science): HAL Theses homepage: open-access repository for French PhD dissertations

## Featured Dissertations

- [Vers une reconnaissance dans les processus collaboratifs](https://theses.hal.science/tel-05558566v1): Doctoral thesis by Levacque on facilitation ethics and recognition in collaborative processes
- [Feuilletages de Calabi-Yau, déformations et structures multifeuilletées](https://theses.hal.science/tel-05558543v1): Doctoral thesis by Danain-Bertoncini on Calabi-Yau foliations and deformation theory
- [Coupled modeling of ductile and brittle fracture for transition simulation](https://theses.hal.science/tel-05558460v1): Doctoral thesis by Guerret on fracture mechanics for nuclear power plant safety
- [Privacy and confidentiality preserving data sharing methods](https://theses.hal.science/tel-05558452v1): Doctoral thesis by Stippel on privacy-preserving data sharing for energy systems
- [A multi-country investigation into relationship quality](https://theses.hal.science/tel-05558451v1): Doctoral thesis by Silan on measuring romantic relationship quality across cultures

## Optional

- [Search - HAL Open Archive (Recent)](https://theses.hal.science/browse/last): Search interface showing recent theses (access-denied error page)
- [Search - HAL Open Archive (By Domain)](https://theses.hal.science/browse/domain): Domain-based thesis search interface (robot-detection error page)
- [Search - HAL Open Archive (By Period)](https://theses.hal.science/browse/period): Period-based thesis search interface (access-blocked error page)
- [Search - HAL Open Archive (By Collection)](https://theses.hal.science/browse/collection): Collection-based thesis search interface (access-denied error page)
